description: The test files a piece of work may change or delete: the path, the number of the change it follows from (or the work that names the internal module it deletes), and the work that changes it. Only the maintainer adds a row, copied from the description of the work.

allowed.change: the description of the work names this file as a place to add tools to (the tools of counting work); the tests themselves do not change
allowed.unit: the base of the tests that count work
